  consumeDigits() {
    const q = this._digitQueue;
    this._digitQueue = [];
    return q;
  }

  consumeLMB() {
    const v = this._lmbQueued;
    this._lmbQueued = false;
    return v;
  }

  consumeRMB() {
    const v = this._rmbQueued;
    this._rmbQueued = false;
    return v;
  }

  consumeWheel() {
    const v = this.wheelDelta;
    this.wheelDelta = 0;
    return v;
  }

  // Clear per-frame mouse deltas after all systems consumed them.
  endFrame() {
    this.mouseDX = 0;
    this.mouseDY = 0;
    this.wheelDelta = 0;
  }
}
```

### src/lobby.js
```
// lobby.js - pre-game lobby (nickname, live avatar editor + rotating preview, map select) and the in-game ESC menu
import * as THREE from "three";
import { CONFIG } from "./config.js";
import { makeMaterials } from "./voxel.js";
import { AVATAR_PRESETS, HAIR_VARIANTS, DEFAULT_AVATAR, sanitizeAvatar, buildAvatarModel, buildCharacterGroup } from "./avatar.js";
import { MAP_IDS, DEFAULT_MAP_ID } from "./maps/index.js";

const LS_NICK = "voxd.nick";
const LS_AVATAR = "voxd.avatar";
const LS_MAP = "voxd.map";

// Map cards: CSS two-tone swatch (sky over ground) + a voxel elevation of the site + name +
// one-liner. Order = town, yard, canyon, then the dev plaza last. Colors are pulled from each map's
// real env (documented in the brief).
//
// `sil` is that elevation, drawn as plain blocks so the card reads as a scale drawing of what you're
// about to knock down: [leftPercent, widthPercent, heightPx, bottomOffsetPx, shadeIndex]. `silc` holds
// the two block tones. `lean` names the one block that tips when the card is live (picked by hand —
// it has to be something that would plausibly go first, not a crane jib with nothing under it).
export const MAP_CARDS = [
  { id: "town", name: "Fallbrook", top: "#8fb7e0", bottom: "#7d8471", sub: "Small town · brick & timber",
    silc: ["#7a6350", "#584639"], lean: 2,
    sil: [[4, 17, 15, 0, 0], [23, 15, 22, 0, 1], [40, 21, 29, 0, 0], [63, 13, 17, 0, 1], [78, 18, 24, 0, 0]] },
  { id: "yard", name: "Graywater Freight Yard", top: "#9ab4d0", bottom: "#8a8d90", sub: "Industrial · concrete & metal",
    silc: ["#6f7378", "#4e5257"], lean: 1,
    sil: [[3, 21, 9, 0, 0], [3, 15, 9, 9, 1], [28, 21, 9, 0, 1], [55, 6, 31, 0, 0], [55, 28, 4, 31, 0], [84, 14, 13, 0, 1]] },
  { id: "canyon", name: "Redgate Basin", top: "#a8c0d8", bottom: "#c8a86b", sub: "Desert canyon · water",
    silc: ["#b0884a", "#8a6738"], lean: 1,
    sil: [[0, 25, 17, 0, 1], [21, 33, 29, 0, 0], [56, 19, 13, 0, 1], [73, 27, 22, 0, 0]] },
  { id: "plaza", name: "Test Plaza (dev)", top: "#8fb7e0", bottom: "#8a8d90", sub: "Original test range",
    silc: ["#8a8d90", "#63666a"], lean: 1,
    sil: [[10, 15, 10, 0, 1], [37, 25, 34, 0, 0], [69, 17, 14, 0, 1]] },
];

const COLOR_ROWS = [
  { key: "skin", label: "Skin", presets: AVATAR_PRESETS.skin },
  { key: "hair", label: "Hair", presets: AVATAR_PRESETS.hair },
  { key: "top", label: "Top", presets: AVATAR_PRESETS.top },
  { key: "bottom", label: "Bottom", presets: AVATAR_PRESETS.bottom },
  { key: "shoes", label: "Shoes", presets: AVATAR_PRESETS.shoes },
];

// --- Nickname + storage helpers (shared with main.js's ?quick=1 path) ------------------------
export function sanitizeNick(str) {
  let s = typeof str === "string" ? str : "";
  s = s.replace(/[␀-]/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (s.length > CONFIG.lobby.nickMaxLen) s = s.slice(0, CONFIG.lobby.nickMaxLen);
  return s.length ? s : "Player";
}

export function loadNick() {
  try { return sanitizeNick(localStorage.getItem(LS_NICK) || ""); } catch (e) { return "Player"; }
}
export function saveNick(nick) { try { localStorage.setItem(LS_NICK, nick); } catch (e) {} }

export function loadAvatar() {
  try { return sanitizeAvatar(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_AVATAR) || "null")); } catch (e) { return sanitizeAvatar(null); }
}
export function saveAvatar(avatar) { try { localStorage.setItem(LS_AVATAR, JSON.stringify(avatar)); } catch (e) {} }

// Preselect priority: ?map= (if valid) > stored voxd.map (if valid) > default map.
export function resolveMapId(preMapId) {
  if (MAP_IDS.includes(preMapId)) return preMapId;
  let stored = null;
  try { stored = localStorage.getItem(LS_MAP); } catch (e) {}
  if (MAP_IDS.includes(stored)) return stored;
  return DEFAULT_MAP_ID;
}
export function saveMapId(id) { try { localStorage.setItem(LS_MAP, id); } catch (e) {} }

// --- Lobby -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export class Lobby {
  // `net` (optional Phase 6 NetClient) drives the session banner + forced-map state. When a LAN session
  // is already running, later joiners are locked to its map. Offline / no session => full Phase 5 choice.
  constructor({ preMapId, onPlay, net = null }) {
    this.onPlay = onPlay;
    this.net = net;
    this._forcedMapId = null;
    this.visible = false;
    this._raf = null;
    this._last = 0;

    this.avatar = loadAvatar();
    this.selectedMapId = resolveMapId(preMapId);

    this.root = document.getElementById("lobby");
    this.nickInput = document.getElementById("lb-nick");
    this.playBtn = document.getElementById("lb-play");
    this.previewCanvas = document.getElementById("lb-preview");

    this.nickInput.value = loadNick();

    this._buildAvatarRows();
    this._buildMapCards();
    this._initPreview();

    this.playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => this._play());
    this.nickInput.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.code === "Enter") this._play(); });

    // Arrow keys cycle map cards; Enter starts. Both are ignored while typing in the nickname field
    // and while focus sits inside an avatar chip row — those rows run their own arrow navigation
    // (roving tabindex) and answer Enter/Space with the button's native click.
    this._onKey = (e) => {
      if (!this.visible) return;
      if (document.activeElement === this.nickInput) return;
      if (this._inChipRow()) return;
      if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "ArrowDown") { this._stepMap(1); e.preventDefault(); }
      else if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "ArrowUp") { this._stepMap(-1); e.preventDefault(); }
      else if (e.code === "Enter") { this._play(); e.preventDefault(); }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", this._onKey);

    this._buildSessionBanner();
    if (net) {
      net.onSession = (s) => this.applySessionState(s);
      if (net.session) this.applySessionState(net.session);
    }
  }

  // A one-line banner above the PLAY button. Styling lives in the stylesheet (.lb-session); only the
  // display toggle stays inline, because main.js flips it to "block" on a full-session reject.
  _buildSessionBanner() {
    const b = document.createElement("div");
    b.id = "lb-session";
    b.className = "lb-session";
    b.setAttribute("role", "status");
    b.style.display = "none";
    this.playBtn.parentNode.insertBefore(b, this.playBtn);
    this._banner = b;
  }

  // True while keyboard focus is on one of the avatar chips (colour swatch / hair shape).
  _inChipRow() {
    const a = document.activeElement;
    return !!(a && a.classList && (a.classList.contains("lb-swatch") || a.classList.contains("lb-shape")));
  }

  // Roving tabindex + Left/Right/Home/End inside one chip row. Keys handled here are stopped so the
  // window-level map stepper never sees them.
  _wireChipRow(btns) {
    const focusAt = (i) => {
      const n = btns.length;
      const t = btns[((i % n) + n) % n];
      t.focus();
      t.click();
    };
    for (let i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
      btns[i].addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        switch (e.code) {
          case "ArrowRight": case "ArrowDown": focusAt(i + 1); break;
          case "ArrowLeft": case "ArrowUp": focusAt(i - 1); break;
          case "Home": focusAt(0); break;
          case "End": focusAt(btns.length - 1); break;
          case "Enter": case "Space": e.stopPropagation(); return; // let the button click itself
          default: return;
        }
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      });
    }
  }

  // Called from the server's `session` push. Active session => lock the map to session.mapId.
  applySessionState(s) {
    if (s && s.active && s.mapId) {
      this._forcedMapId = s.mapId;
      this.selectedMapId = s.mapId;
      this._refreshMaps();
      const card = MAP_CARDS.find((c) => c.id === s.mapId);
      const name = card ? card.name : s.mapId;
      this._banner.textContent = `Session in progress on ${name} (${s.count} online) — you'll join this map.`;
      this._banner.style.display = "flex";
      for (const el of this._mapEls) {
        const locked = el.dataset.id !== s.mapId;
        // Hatched-out rather than faded to 35%: the card still has to be readable, because it is
        // the thing that explains why you can't pick it. `disabled` also drops it from the tab order.
        el.classList.toggle("lb-card-locked", locked);
        el.disabled = locked;
        if (locked) el.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true"); else el.removeAttribute("aria-disabled");
      }
    } else {
      this._forcedMapId = null;
      if (this._banner) this._banner.style.display = "none";
      for (const el of this._mapEls) {
        el.classList.remove("lb-card-locked");
        el.removeAttribute("aria-disabled");
        el.disabled = false;
      }
    }
  }

  // One row per editable slot: a mono label in the left column, the chips in the right. Each row is a
  // radiogroup — only the picked chip is tabbable, arrows move within the row.
  _buildAvatarRows() {
    const host = document.getElementById("lb-avatar");
    host.innerHTML = "";
    this._colorBtns = {};
    const makeRow = (label) => {
      const r = document.createElement("div");
      r.className = "lb-row";
      r.setAttribute("role", "radiogroup");
      r.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
      const lab = document.createElement("div");
      lab.className = "lb-row-label";
      lab.textContent = label;
      const ctl = document.createElement("div");
      ctl.className = "lb-row-ctl lb-chips";
      r.appendChild(lab);
      r.appendChild(ctl);
      host.appendChild(r);
      return ctl;
    };

    for (const row of COLOR_ROWS) {
      const ctl = makeRow(row.label);
      const btns = [];
      row.presets.forEach((hex, i) => {
        const b = document.createElement("button");
        b.type = "button";
        b.className = "lb-swatch";
        b.style.background = hex;
        b.title = hex;
        b.setAttribute("role", "radio");
        b.setAttribute("aria-label", `${row.label} ${i + 1}`);
        b.addEventListener("click", () => {
          this.avatar.colors[row.key] = i;
          this._afterEdit();
          this._refreshRow(row.key);
        });
        ctl.appendChild(b);
        btns.push(b);
      });
      this._colorBtns[row.key] = btns;
      this._wireChipRow(btns);
    }

    // Hair shape row.
    const hctl = makeRow("Hair style");
    this._hairBtns = {};
    const hbtns = [];
    for (const variant of HAIR_VARIANTS) {
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.className = "lb-shape";
      b.setAttribute("role", "radio");
      b.textContent = variant.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + variant.slice(1);
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        this.avatar.hair = variant;
        this._afterEdit();
        this._refreshHair();
      });
      hctl.appendChild(b);
      this._hairBtns[variant] = b;
      hbtns.push(b);
    }
    this._wireChipRow(hbtns);

    for (const row of COLOR_ROWS) this._refreshRow(row.key);
    this._refreshHair();
  }

  _refreshRow(key) {
    const sel = this.avatar.colors[key];
    const btns = this._colorBtns[key];
    for (let i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
      const on = i === sel;
      btns[i].classList.toggle("lb-sel", on);
      btns[i].setAttribute("aria-checked", on ? "true" : "false");
      btns[i].tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
    }
  }
  _refreshHair() {
    for (const variant of HAIR_VARIANTS) {
      const on = variant === this.avatar.hair;
      const b = this._hairBtns[variant];
      b.classList.toggle("lb-sel", on);
      b.setAttribute("aria-checked", on ? "true" : "false");
      b.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
    }
  }

  _afterEdit() {
    saveAvatar(this.avatar);
    this._rebuildPreview();
  }

  _buildMapCards() {
    const host = document.getElementById("lb-maps");
    host.innerHTML = "";
    this._mapEls = [];
    for (const card of MAP_CARDS) {
      const el = document.createElement("button");
      el.type = "button";
      el.className = "lb-card";
      el.dataset.id = card.id;
      el.setAttribute("role", "radio");

      const sw = document.createElement("span");
      sw.className = "lb-card-swatch";
      sw.style.background = `linear-gradient(${card.top} 0 62%, ${card.bottom} 62% 100%)`;
      // Voxel elevation of the site; one hand-picked block leans when the card is live.
      (card.sil || []).forEach(([x, w, h, b, shade], i) => {
        const blk = document.createElement("i");
        blk.className = "lb-blk" + (i === card.lean ? " lb-blk-t" : "");
        blk.style.left = x + "%";
        blk.style.width = w + "%";
        blk.style.height = h + "px";
        blk.style.bottom = 25 + b + "px";
        blk.style.background = card.silc[shade];
        sw.appendChild(blk);
      });

      const nm = document.createElement("span");
      nm.className = "lb-card-name";
      nm.textContent = card.name;
      const sub = document.createElement("span");
      sub.className = "lb-card-sub";
      sub.textContent = card.sub;
      el.appendChild(sw);
      el.appendChild(nm);
      el.appendChild(sub);

      const pick = () => { if (this._forcedMapId) return; this.selectedMapId = card.id; this._refreshMaps(); };
      el.addEventListener("click", pick);
      // Focus follows selection and selection follows focus: the card you're on is the site you get,
      // so Enter (handled at window level) always starts the site under the cursor/caret.
      el.addEventListener("focus", pick);
      host.appendChild(el);
      this._mapEls.push(el);
    }
    this._refreshMaps();
  }

  _refreshMaps() {
    for (const el of this._mapEls) {
      const on = el.dataset.id === this.selectedMapId;
      el.classList.toggle("lb-card-sel", on);
      el.setAttribute("aria-checked", on ? "true" : "false");
      el.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
    }
  }

  _stepMap(dir) {
    if (this._forcedMapId) return;
    let i = MAP_CARDS.findIndex((c) => c.id === this.selectedMapId);
    i = (i + dir + MAP_CARDS.length) % MAP_CARDS.length;
    this.selectedMapId = MAP_CARDS[i].id;
    this._refreshMaps();
    // Only chase the focus ring when the user is already inside the card group.
    const active = document.activeElement;
    if (active && active.classList && active.classList.contains("lb-card")) {
      const el = this._mapEls.find((e) => e.dataset.id === this.selectedMapId);
      if (el) el.focus();
    }
  }

  // --- Live preview (own renderer + rAF, runs only while the lobby is visible) ---
  _initPreview() {
    const W = 280, H = 400;
    this.previewCanvas.width = W;
    this.previewCanvas.height = H;
    this.pr = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas: this.previewCanvas, antialias: true, alpha: true });
    this.pr.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, CONFIG.render.pixelRatioCap));
    this.pr.setSize(W, H, false);
    this.pr.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

    this.pscene = new THREE.Scene();
    this.pcam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(CONFIG.lobby.previewFov, W / H, 0.1, 50);
    this.pcam.position.set(0, 1.0, 3.4);
    this.pcam.lookAt(0, 0.95, 0);

    // Same light the maps use: one hard warm key from the upper right, cool sky fill, plus a cold rim
    // from behind-left so the silhouette separates from the dark hoarding.
    const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xbcd6f2, 0x6b6f5f, 0.75);
    this.pscene.add(hemi);
    const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2df, 2.2);
    dir.position.set(2.5, 4, 3);
    this.pscene.add(dir);
    const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x9fc4ea, 0.85);
    rim.position.set(-3.2, 1.8, -2.4);
    this.pscene.add(rim);

    this.pmats = makeMaterials();
    this.pivot = new THREE.Group();
    this.pscene.add(this.pivot);
    this.charGroup = null;
    this._rebuildPreview();
    this._initPreviewDrag();
  }

  // Drag-to-turn: 1:1 with the pointer while held, then the release velocity is handed straight to
  // the idle spin and eased back to the ambient rate, so there's no seam between drag and animation.
  _initPreviewDrag() {
    const c = this.previewCanvas;
    this._spinVel = CONFIG.lobby.previewRotSpeed;
    this._dragging = false;
    let lastX = 0, lastT = 0;

    c.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
      c.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      this._dragging = true;
      this._spinVel = 0;
      lastX = e.clientX;
      lastT = performance.now();
      c.classList.add("is-grabbing");
      e.preventDefault();
    });
    c.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
      if (!this._dragging) return;
      const now = performance.now();
      const dx = e.clientX - lastX;
      const dt = Math.max(8, now - lastT) / 1000;
      const dTheta = dx * 0.011;
      this.pivot.rotation.y += dTheta;
      this._spinVel = Math.max(-12, Math.min(12, dTheta / dt)); // carried into the release
      lastX = e.clientX;
      lastT = now;
    });
    const end = () => {
      if (!this._dragging) return;
      this._dragging = false;
      c.classList.remove("is-grabbing");
    };
    c.addEventListener("pointerup", end);
    c.addEventListener("pointercancel", end);
    c.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", end);
  }

  _rebuildPreview() {
    if (this.charGroup) {
      this.pivot.remove(this.charGroup);
      this.charGroup.traverse((o) => { if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); });
    }
    const model = buildAvatarModel(this.avatar);
    this.charGroup = buildCharacterGroup(model, this.pmats);
    this.pivot.add(this.charGroup);
  }

  _startPreview() {
    if (this._raf != null) return;
    // Reduced motion: park the character at a readable three-quarter angle instead of spinning it.
    // Dragging still works — motion the user asks for is never the problem.
    const calm = typeof matchMedia === "function" && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const idle = calm ? 0 : CONFIG.lobby.previewRotSpeed;
    if (calm && this._spinVel !== 0) { this.pivot.rotation.y = -0.5; this._spinVel = 0; }
    this._last = performance.now();
    const loop = () => {
      const now = performance.now();
      let dt = (now - this._last) / 1000;
      this._last = now;
      if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;
      if (!this._dragging) {
        // Exponential approach back to the ambient rate: a flick keeps spinning, then settles.
        this._spinVel += (idle - this._spinVel) * (1 - Math.pow(0.14, dt));
        this.pivot.rotation.y += this._spinVel * dt;
      }
      this.pr.render(this.pscene, this.pcam);
      this._raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    this._raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  _stopPreview() {
    if (this._raf != null) { cancelAnimationFrame(this._raf); this._raf = null; }
  }

  show() {
    this.visible = true;
    this.root.style.display = "flex";
    this._startPreview();
  }

  hide() {
    this.visible = false;
    this._stopPreview();
    this.root.style.display = "none";
  }

  _play() {
    if (this.playBtn.disabled) return;
    const nick = sanitizeNick(this.nickInput.value);
    saveNick(nick);
    saveAvatar(this.avatar);
    saveMapId(this.selectedMapId);
    const card = MAP_CARDS.find((c) => c.id === this.selectedMapId);
    this.playBtn.disabled = true;
    // `is-loading` only paints while the button is also disabled, so main.js's full-session reject
    // (which just re-enables it) drops back to the idle look without needing to know about the class.
    this.playBtn.classList.add("is-loading");
    this.playBtn.textContent = "Loading " + (card ? card.name : this.selectedMapId) + "…";
    this._stopPreview(); // free the preview rAF before the heavy game load begins
    this.onPlay({ mapId: this.selectedMapId, avatar: this.avatar, nick });
  }
}

// --- In-game ESC menu ------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Opened on pointer-lock loss while playing (the browser swallows the ESC keydown under lock).
// Resume re-locks; Reset restores the map; Back to lobby reloads with ?map=. The sim keeps running
// underneath (main.js folds isOpen into its menuOpen path).
export class GameMenu {
  constructor({ onResume, onReset, onLobby }) {
    this.isOpen = false;
    this.root = document.getElementById("game-menu");
    this.hintEl = document.getElementById("gm-hint");
    this.flashEl = document.getElementById("gm-flash");
    this._resetting = false;
    this._flashTimer = 0;

    document.getElementById("gm-resume").addEventListener("click", () => { if (onResume) onResume(); });
    document.getElementById("gm-lobby").addEventListener("click", () => { if (onLobby) onLobby(); });
    document.getElementById("gm-reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (this._resetting) return;
      this._resetting = true;
      clearTimeout(this._flashTimer);
      this._setFlash("Resetting…", "busy");
      // Two frames, not one: a single rAF callback runs BEFORE the paint of the style change that
      // scheduled it, so "Resetting…" never reached the screen. The second frame guarantees it has.
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        try { if (onReset) onReset(); } finally {
          // Status -> completion. The rebuild is instant, so without the confirmation the only
          // evidence that anything happened is off-screen behind the pause board.
          this._setFlash("Map restored", "done");
          this._flashTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this.flashEl.style.opacity = "0";
            this._resetting = false;
          }, 1400);
        }
      }));
    });
  }

  _setFlash(text, state) {
    this.flashEl.textContent = text;
    this.flashEl.dataset.state = state;
    this.flashEl.style.opacity = "1";
  }

  open() {
    this.isOpen = true;
    this.hintEl.style.opacity = "0";
    this.root.style.display = "flex";
  }

  // Re-show after a failed re-lock (Chrome's ~1.25 s cooldown after an ESC-triggered exit).
  openWithHint() {
    this.isOpen = true;
    this.hintEl.textContent = "Couldn't grab the mouse — click Resume again.";
    this.hintEl.style.opacity = "1";
    this.root.style.display = "flex";
  }

  close() {
    this.isOpen = false;
    this.root.style.display = "none";
  }
}

// =================================================================================================
// Shell enhancements — three in-game surfaces that are built by files this module does not own
// (menu.js builds the vehicle tiles, weapons.js writes the tool readout, main.js writes the map tag).
// Rather than reach into those files, this section watches the DOM they produce and dresses it, so
// the ownership boundary stays where it is and every hook keeps working untouched.
//
// Everything here degrades to what shipped before: if a name is unknown, the tile keeps its letter,
// the tool readout keeps its number + name, and the pause board keeps its default kicker.
// =================================================================================================
